issue: What standard of appellate review applies to mixed questions of law and fact in reviewing a district court's pretrial detention order under the Bail Reform Act: de novo, or deferential?

sides.position: Mixed questions in pretrial detention orders are reviewed de novo, as legal questions.
Mixed questions in pretrial detention orders receive deferential review because the district court is better positioned to decide them.

quote: And our sister circuits have split on the issue.
cite: United States v. Kyle Wagner, No. 26-1294 (6th Cir. 2026)
